title: Microsoft 365 workspace ownership
subtitle: Map workspaces, fix ownership gaps, and confirm owners each quarter.

steps.title: Map every workspace
steps.evidence: Inventory Teams, SharePoint sites and Microsoft 365 groups

steps.title: Flag ownership gaps
steps.evidence: Rencore policies flag Teams, sites and groups that are ownerless, have fewer than two owners, or are owned by disabled accounts.

steps.title: Assign active employee owners
steps.evidence: Each workspace should have at least two active employee owners, and guests should never be the sole owner.

steps.title: Prioritise higher risk workspaces
steps.evidence: Workspaces with disabled owners, external guests or sensitive content should be prioritised

steps.title: Confirm ownership quarterly
steps.evidence: Quarterly reviews confirm that owners remain responsible and members are appropriate, while unanswered requests are escalated and confirmations retained as evidence.
